en.title: MORE BackstopVault
en.subtitle: Half of this token's trading tax lands here and defends the sUSD side of its MORE pool.
en.flow.description: The vault holds the launch's protocol-owned first-loss xNVDA and accumulates tBNB from the 50% VAULT tax slot. Its buffer is valued with the Atlas BNB/USD feed. Cover limits: at most 50% of the buffer per day for the live pool. The same vault may also cover the team's demo ScenarioPool, whose price is set by the team: at most 20% of the buffer per day and at most 10% of all revenue ever. Flap's Guardian can upgrade the vault implementation through its beacon; there is no other admin.
en.hints.coverState: Cover opens only while the pool's collateral ratio is below 100%. Each day the vault can spend at most 50% of its buffer on the live pool, and never more than the pool's shortfall.
en.hints.walletState: Any wallet can call cover. It pays only gas.
en.hints.cover: Send a permissionless cover transaction for the defended pool.
en.errors.connectWallet: Connect a wallet to send cover.
en.errors.switchNetwork: Switch to the vault's network before sending cover.
en.errors.stageUnavailable: Cover is unavailable in the current market phase.
en.errors.noPool: The MORE pool has not been opened yet. Call openPool on the Launcher first.
en.errors.ratioUnavailable: The pool collateral ratio is unavailable right now.
en.errors.poolHealthy: The pool's collateral ratio is at or above 100%, so cover is not needed.
en.errors.txFailed: The cover transaction failed. Refresh and try again.
en.notices.riskMissing: The host did not supply this Vault's contract risk status. Treat it as unverified.
en.errors.cannotCover: The vault cannot cover right now: the buffer is empty, the price is stale, or today's cap is used up.
en.poolApp.title: Use the NVDA pool
en.poolApp.hint: Mint or redeem sUSD and xNVDA, or deposit into the insurance vault, in the MORE pool Mini App.
en.poolApp.fallback: Open {path} on Flap to use the NVDA pool.

zh.title: MORE BackstopVault
zh.subtitle: 此代币一半的交易税进入这里，用于保护其 MORE 池的 sUSD 一侧。
zh.flow.description: 金库持有本次发射的协议自有首亏 xNVDA，并累积 50% VAULT 税档的 tBNB，缓冲金按 Atlas BNB/USD 计价。注资上限：正式池子每天最多用缓冲金的 50%。同一个金库也可以为团队的演示池 ScenarioPool 注资（价格由团队设定）：每天最多缓冲金的 20%，累计不超过总收入的 10%。Flap 的 Guardian 可以通过 beacon 升级金库实现，除此之外没有其他管理员。
zh.hints.coverState: 只有池子抵押率低于 100% 时才能注资。金库每天最多花缓冲金的 50% 给正式池子，且不超过池子的缺口。
zh.hints.walletState: 任何钱包都可调用 cover，只需支付 gas。
zh.hints.cover: 为受保护池发送一笔无需许可的 cover 交易。
zh.errors.connectWallet: 请连接钱包后再发送注资。
zh.errors.switchNetwork: 请先切换到金库所在网络。
zh.errors.stageUnavailable: 当前市场阶段无法注资。
zh.errors.noPool: MORE 池尚未开启，请先在 Launcher 上调用 openPool。
zh.errors.ratioUnavailable: 暂时无法读取池抵押率。
zh.errors.poolHealthy: 池抵押率不低于 100%，无需注资。
zh.errors.txFailed: 注资交易失败，请刷新后重试。
zh.notices.riskMissing: Host 未提供此 Vault 的合约风险状态，请视为未验证。
zh.notices.readsUnavailable: 暂时无法读取金库数据。
zh.errors.cannotCover: 金库现在无法注资：缓冲金为空、价格过期，或今日额度已用完。
zh.states.coverBlocked: 低于 100%，但暂时无法注资（见原因）
zh.poolApp.title: 使用 NVDA 池
zh.poolApp.hint: 在 MORE 池小程序中铸造或赎回 sUSD 和 xNVDA，或存入保险金库。
zh.poolApp.fallback: 请在 Flap 上打开 {path} 使用 NVDA 池。
